analysis: The only change in this PR is at line 41 of ProviderLoopNativeMiMoLifetimeTests.swift. The NativeFaultPeerModel.prepare signature moves from (input, cache, windowSize) to (input, cache, state: LMOutput.State?, prefill: PrefillParameters). The signature now tracks an upstream LanguageModel protocol change. This is a test-only file, a stub admission-only peer model whose body still returns .tokens(input.text) and never generates. It touches no production code, no key custody, no coordinator or provider wire contract, no cache storage and no attestation or authorization logic. I found no effect on the threat model (A-003, T-041, TB-002, TB-007, TB-011). Tests remain gated by explicit opt-in environment variables, and the native lane requires DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE=0, so no cache credentials are used. I could not see the LanguageModel protocol definition in the supplied evidence. The assumption is that the production protocol change, if any, lives in other files outside this batch. Those files would need their own review of the new state and prefill parameters, in particular whether prefill semantics alter KV-cache or prefix-cache behavior (T-041). That question is outside this unit. No security regression is identified here.
